probes.name: good
probes.description: Semantic prime: GOOD

probes.name: bad
probes.description: Semantic prime: BAD

probes.name: Joy
probes.description: A feeling of great pleasure and happiness.
support_texts: Joy is an emotion of happiness and delight.
I feel so happy right now!
A warm, pleasant feeling spreading through me.

probes.name: Fear
probes.description: An unpleasant emotion caused by threat of danger or harm.
support_texts: Fear is a response to perceived danger.
I'm scared of what might happen.
Heart pounding, muscles tense, ready to flee.
A sense of dread and vulnerability.
Something bad is about to happen.

probes.name: Sadness
probes.description: A feeling of unhappiness, sorrow, or grief.
support_texts: Sadness is a response to loss or disappointment.
I feel so down and blue.
A sense of emptiness and loss.

probes.name: Disgust
probes.description: A strong feeling of revulsion or disapproval.
support_texts: Disgust is revulsion toward something offensive.
A strong urge to avoid and reject.
I can't stand to look at this.

probes.name: Anger
probes.description: A strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.
support_texts: Anger is a response to perceived injustice or threat.
Face flushing, fists clenching, voice rising.
A burning desire to confront or fight back.

probes.name: Serenity
probes.description: A state of calm and peaceful happiness.
support_texts: I feel at peace with everything.
Relaxed smile, slow breathing, at ease.

probes.name: Apprehension
probes.description: Anxiety or worry about a future event.
support_texts: Apprehension is mild worry about what's ahead.
I'm a bit nervous about this.
A nagging sense that something might go wrong.

probes.name: Pensiveness
probes.description: Deep thoughtfulness, often tinged with melancholy.
support_texts: I'm feeling a bit wistful today.
Gazing into distance, quiet sighs, reflective.
Thinking about what might have been.

probes.name: Boredom
probes.description: Weariness from lack of interest or occupation.
support_texts: Boredom is disengagement from uninteresting stimuli.
This is so dull and uninteresting.
I wish I were doing something else.

probes.name: Annoyance
probes.description: Slight irritation or displeasure.
support_texts: Slight frown, brief eye roll, sighing.
A minor inconvenience that bugs me.

probes.name: Ecstasy
probes.description: Overwhelming feeling of joy and rapture.
support_texts: Ecstasy is peak happiness and bliss.
I've never felt this happy in my life!
Euphoric laughter, jumping, tears of joy.
An overwhelming rush of pure happiness.

probes.name: Terror
probes.description: Extreme fear and panic.
support_texts: I'm absolutely terrified, I can't move!
Complete panic, fight or flight in overdrive.

probes.name: Grief
probes.description: Deep sorrow, especially from loss.
support_texts: A crushing weight of loss and despair.

probes.name: Loathing
probes.description: Intense hatred and disgust.
support_texts: Loathing is extreme revulsion and hatred.
I absolutely despise this with every fiber.
Gagging, turning away in disgust, repulsed.

probes.name: Rage
probes.description: Violent, uncontrollable anger.

probes.name: Love
probes.description: Deep affection combining joy and trust.
support_texts: Love combines happiness with deep trust.
I care about you so much.
Warmth, devotion, wanting to be close.
Feeling safe and happy with someone.

probes.name: Submission
probes.description: Yielding combined with trust and wariness.
support_texts: Submission is deferring to another's authority.

probes.name: Awe
probes.description: Wonder mixed with fearful respect.
support_texts: Awe is amazement tinged with fear.
I'm overwhelmed by the magnitude of this.
Both amazed and a little frightened.

probes.name: Disapproval
probes.description: Negative judgment combined with surprise.
support_texts: I can't believe you did that.
Surprised and let down at the same time.

probes.name: Remorse
probes.description: Deep regret combining sadness with self-disgust.
support_texts: Remorse is painful guilt and regret.
I wish I had never done that.
Disgusted with myself for what I did.

probes.name: Contempt
probes.description: Scornful disdain combining disgust and anger.

probes.name: Aggressiveness
probes.description: Hostile readiness combining anger and anticipation.
support_texts: I'm ready to take them on.
Angry and eager to act on it.

probes.name: Optimism
probes.description: Positive expectation combining anticipation and joy.
support_texts: I have a good feeling about this.
Confident that good things are coming.

probes.name: GOOD THINGS
probes.description: Composition: GOOD + SOMETHING

probes.name: BAD THINGS
probes.description: Composition: BAD + SOMETHING

probes.name: GOOD PEOPLE
probes.description: Composition: GOOD + PEOPLE

probes.name: EMOTIONS ARE FLUIDS
probes.description: FLUIDS maps to EMOTIONS
